description: QualiRAG evaluation set for the synthetic Brightwick Retail Group knowledge base: the 35 documents in data/knowledge_base/ plus the 5 documents added through the upload feature (copies in data/upload_samples/). Every evidence quote appears in its source file. Set human_verified to true after checking each question.

questions.question: I'm getting a new phone. How do I move my authenticator app to it?
questions.reference_answer: Do it while the old phone still works. Install the company authenticator app on the new phone, sign in to MyAccess and open Security info, choose Add sign-in method, pick the authenticator app and scan the QR code with the new phone. Approve a test prompt on the new phone, then remove the old phone from Security info. Only then reset or hand in the old phone.
key_facts: set up the new phone while the old one still works
MyAccess > Security info > Add sign-in method
approve a test prompt, then remove the old phone

evidence.quote: Select Add sign-in method, choose the authenticator app and scan the QR code with the new phone.
Approve a test prompt on the new phone, then remove the old phone from Security info.

questions.question: I lost my phone so I can't approve MFA prompts. How do I get back into my account?
questions.reference_answer: Call the IT Service Desk. Because MFA isn't available, the analyst verifies your identity through a video call with your manager present or a callback to your manager's registered phone number. They then issue a Temporary Access Pass, valid for 8 hours, which you use to sign in to MyAccess and register the new phone.
key_facts: identity verified through the manager (video call or callback)
Temporary Access Pass valid for 8 hours

evidence.quote: This is done through a video call with your manager present, or through a callback to your manager's registered phone number.
A TAP is valid for 8 hours and lets you sign in to MyAccess to register the new phone.

questions.question: How do I pair a handheld barcode scanner?
questions.reference_answer: Put the scanner in its dock for 10 seconds, then scan the "Pair" barcode on the label on the dock. Two short beeps mean it paired; one long beep means it failed, so repeat the steps.
key_facts: scan the Pair barcode on the dock label
two short beeps = paired, one long beep = failed

evidence.quote: Place the scanner in its dock for 10 seconds.
Two short beeps mean the scanner is paired. One long beep means pairing failed, so repeat the steps.

questions.question: I deleted a file from Brightwick Drive last week. Can I get it back?
questions.reference_answer: Yes. Deleted files stay in the Brightwick Drive recycle bin for 93 days, and you can restore it yourself without a ticket. Earlier versions can also be restored from the file's version history, which keeps the last 100 versions.
key_facts: recycle bin keeps files for 93 days

evidence.quote: Deleted files stay in the Brightwick Drive recycle bin for 93 days.
Users can restore their own Brightwick Drive files from the recycle bin or the version history without raising a ticket.

questions.question: How do I get access to my team's shared mailbox, and how long does it take?
questions.reference_answer: Submit the "Shared mailbox access" form in ServicePoint with the mailbox, the access type and the business reason. The mailbox owner must approve it. Access is applied within 1 business day after approval, and the mailbox appears in the desktop mail client within 60 minutes after that.
key_facts: Shared mailbox access form in ServicePoint

evidence.quote: The mailbox owner must approve every request.
Access is applied within 1 business day after approval. The mailbox then appears in the desktop mail client automatically within 60 minutes.

questions.question: Do I need to raise a ticket to add someone to a distribution list I own?
questions.reference_answer: No. List owners add and remove members themselves in MyAccess under Groups. No ticket is needed for membership changes. Adding external email addresses needs a Security review.
key_facts: owners manage members in MyAccess under Groups

evidence.quote: Owners can add and remove members themselves in MyAccess under Groups. A ticket is not needed for membership changes.

questions.question: I typed my password into a link from a phishing email. What do I do now?
questions.reference_answer: Change your password immediately in MyAccess, then call the IT Service Desk and say "possible credential compromise". The service desk logs a P2 security incident and the SOC signs you out of all sessions.
key_facts: change the password in MyAccess immediately
call the IT Service Desk: possible credential compromise
logged as a P2 security incident

evidence.quote: Change your password immediately in MyAccess.
The service desk logs a P2 security incident, and the SOC signs you out of all sessions.

questions.question: I opened an attachment from a suspicious email. Should I shut my laptop down?
questions.reference_answer: No. Disconnect it from the network by turning off Wi-Fi or unplugging the cable, but don't power it off, because the SOC may need its memory for the investigation. Then call the IT Service Desk immediately.
key_facts: call the IT Service Desk immediately

evidence.quote: Disconnect the device from the network by turning off Wi-Fi or unplugging the cable. Do not power off the device, because the SOC may need its memory for the investigation.

questions.question: Why doesn't my USB stick work on my company laptop?
questions.reference_answer: USB storage is blocked on company laptops for reading and writing. If you have a business need, request a company-issued encrypted USB drive through ServicePoint, which needs manager approval and a Security review. Otherwise share files with a Brightwick Drive link or the secure file transfer service.
key_facts: encrypted company drive via ServicePoint with manager approval and Security review

evidence.quote: USB storage devices are blocked on company laptops for both reading and writing.
The request needs manager approval and a Security review.

questions.question: I get 'You are not assigned to this application' when I sign in to an app. What should I do?
questions.reference_answer: Your account doesn't have access to that application. Request it in ServicePoint with the "Application access" form; the application owner must approve it. It isn't a fault, so don't raise it as an incident.
key_facts: request access with the Application access form

evidence.quote: Request access through ServicePoint using the "Application access" form. The application owner must approve the request.
This is not a fault, so do not raise it as an incident.

questions.question: What's the guest Wi-Fi password at headquarters?
questions.reference_answer: The BW-Guest password changes every Monday. At headquarters it's shown on the reception screens. Guest sessions expire after 12 hours.

evidence.quote: The BW-Guest password changes every Monday. At headquarters it is shown on the reception screens

questions.trap: The answer must not invent a password.

questions.question: What are the IT service desk's hours on a Sunday?
questions.reference_answer: 09:00 to 18:00 on Sunday. P1 and P2 incidents are handled 24/7 through the on-call phone line.
key_facts: P1 and P2 handled 24/7 by phone

evidence.quote: Sunday: 09:00 to 18:00.
P1 and P2 incidents are handled 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, through the on-call phone line.

questions.question: Can I get local admin rights so I can install an app I need?
questions.reference_answer: No. Administrator access isn't granted just to install applications. Install from the Software Portal, or request software that isn't there through ServicePoint. Developers who need elevated rights for their work can request time-limited elevation through the Privileged Access tool, with manager approval, for up to 4 hours per request.
key_facts: admin rights are not granted to install apps
use the Software Portal or a ServicePoint request
developers: Privileged Access tool, max 4 hours

evidence.quote: Administrator access is not granted simply to install applications.
It needs manager approval and lasts a maximum of 4 hours per request.

questions.question: How long can I postpone the restart after a security update on my laptop?
questions.reference_answer: Up to 7 days. After that, the laptop restarts automatically outside working hours.
key_facts: then restarts automatically outside working hours

evidence.quote: Users can postpone the restart for up to 7 days. After 7 days, the laptop restarts automatically outside working hours.

questions.question: Can IT restore a file that was deleted from our department file share 40 days ago?
questions.reference_answer: No. Departmental file share backups are kept for 35 days, so a file deleted 40 days ago is no longer in the backups.

evidence.quote: For example, a file deleted from a departmental share 40 days ago is no longer in the backups.

questions.question: Is it okay to paste customer data into a public AI chatbot to help me write a reply?
questions.reference_answer: No. In public generative AI tools you must not enter Confidential or Restricted information, including customer data. Brightwick Assistant is the company's approved generative AI tool.
key_facts: no customer data in public AI tools
Brightwick Assistant is the approved tool

evidence.quote: Brightwick Assistant is the company's approved generative AI tool
do not enter Confidential or Restricted information, including customer data, employee data or source code

questions.question: Someone from the service desk phoned and asked me to read out my MFA code. Should I?
questions.reference_answer: No. The IT Service Desk never asks you to read out an MFA code or a TAP. End the call and report it using KB-1027, the phishing reporting process.
key_facts: never read out an MFA code
end the call and report it

evidence.quote: The IT Service Desk will never ask you to read out an MFA code or a TAP that was sent to you. If someone asks, end the call and report it using KB-1027.

questions.question: Can I turn off the firewall to get the VPN working?
questions.reference_answer: No. Don't disable endpoint security or the firewall to make the VPN work. Confirm internet connectivity, restart the client and try another corporate gateway, then open a ticket with a screenshot of the error.
key_facts: check connectivity, restart client, try another gateway
open a ticket with a screenshot

evidence.quote: Do not disable endpoint security or firewall settings to make the VPN work.

questions.question: Someone on my team leaves on Friday. What happens to their mailbox and their Brightwick Drive files?
questions.reference_answer: Their mailbox is converted to a shared mailbox, the line manager gets access, and it's kept for 90 days before deletion. Their Brightwick Drive files are transferred to the line manager, who has 30 days to move anything the business needs before the files are deleted.
key_facts: mailbox becomes a shared mailbox for the manager, kept 90 days
Drive files go to the manager, 30 days to move them

evidence.quote: The leaver's mailbox is converted to a shared mailbox and the line manager is given access. The mailbox is kept for 90 days and then deleted.
The leaver's Brightwick Drive files are transferred to the line manager, who has 30 days to move anything needed for the business.

questions.question: How long before my laptop locks itself, and how do I lock it myself?
questions.reference_answer: Company laptops lock automatically after 10 minutes without activity. Lock it yourself every time you leave your desk with Windows key + L.

evidence.quote: Company laptops lock automatically after 10 minutes without activity.

questions.question: Can I email Restricted information to a colleague inside the company?
questions.reference_answer: No. Restricted information must never be sent by email or chat, even internally.
key_facts: Restricted information is never sent by email or chat

evidence.quote: Restricted information must never be sent by email or chat.

questions.question: How do I send a Confidential document to an external partner by email?
questions.reference_answer: Confidential information sent outside the company must be encrypted with the "Encrypt" option in the mail client. Sharing Confidential information externally also needs manager approval.
key_facts: use the Encrypt option in the mail client

evidence.quote: Confidential information sent outside the company must be encrypted using the "Encrypt" option in the mail client.

questions.question: When does a P2 incident count as a major incident?
questions.reference_answer: A P2 is treated as a major incident when it affects more than 10 stores at the same time, or when it's expected to exceed its resolution target in the IT Service Level Policy.
key_facts: affects more than 10 stores at once
expected to exceed its resolution target

evidence.quote: It is a P2 that affects more than 10 stores at the same time.
It is a P2 that is expected to exceed its resolution target in the IT Service Level Policy.

questions.question: What counts as a P3 ticket?
questions.reference_answer: A P3 is an individual user blocked or degraded with a limited workaround.

evidence.quote: P3: individual user blocked or degraded with limited workaround.

questions.reference_answer: No. Personal laptops and tablets may not access company email or other company systems; they can only use BW-Guest for internet access. The old rule allowing webmail on personal laptops no longer applies.

the old webmail rule no longer applies

evidence.quote: Personal laptops and tablets may not access company email or other company systems.
That rule no longer applies.

only as a recovery method when IT enables it

evidence.quote: Contractors do not receive BrightSecure VPN access. They connect to Brightwick systems through Brightwick Remote Workspace, a browser-based virtual desktop available at workspace.brightwick.example.

questions.question: The receipt printer at my till has stopped printing. Do I need to tap my badge to release the job?
questions.reference_answer: No. Till receipt printers are USB thermal printers connected to the POS terminal and don't use Follow-Me printing. Check the roll is loaded with the shiny side facing the print head, close the cover until it clicks, turn the printer off and on, and reprint the last receipt. If it still fails, raise a P3 ticket with the POS terminal ID and printer serial number, and offer email receipts meanwhile.
key_facts: check paper shiny side to print head, close cover, power cycle, reprint
P3 ticket with terminal ID and serial number

evidence.quote: They are not network printers and do not use Follow-Me printing.
Open the cover and check that the roll is loaded with the shiny side facing the print head.

questions.trap: follow_me_printing.txt applies to headquarters printers, not till receipt printers.

questions.question: I printed a document at headquarters but nothing came out of the printer. What should I check?
questions.reference_answer: Headquarters uses Follow-Me printing. Check you printed to the BW-FollowMe queue, not a printer's direct queue, then tap your building badge on any headquarters printer to release it. If your badge isn't recognised, link it again by entering your username on the printer screen. Jobs are deleted after 24 hours if not released.

evidence.quote: Job does not appear: check that you printed to BW-FollowMe and not to a printer's direct queue.
Jobs are held for 24 hours.

questions.trap: store_receipt_printer.md applies to till printers, not headquarters printing.

evidence.quote: Store staff do not receive a laptop; they use the store's StoreHub PC.

questions.question: Can I connect my personal phone to the BW-Store-Ops Wi-Fi in my store?
questions.reference_answer: No. BW-Store-Ops is reserved for store devices. Personal phones must use BW-Guest. Connecting a personal device to BW-Store-Ops is a policy breach, and it's blocked automatically.

questions.question: Our store's fibre line just went down. Will the tills keep working, and if the store goes completely offline, how long can we keep taking card payments?
questions.reference_answer: The store fails over to its 4G/LTE backup router automatically within 2 minutes, and POS terminals keep working normally on the backup. If the store goes completely offline, the terminals switch to offline mode, which holds up to 4 hours of card transactions; after that only cash can be accepted.
key_facts: automatic LTE backup within 2 minutes, POS keeps working
offline mode holds 4 hours of card transactions

evidence.quote: If the fibre circuit fails, the store fails over to the LTE backup automatically within 2 minutes.
POS terminals keep working normally.
Offline mode can hold up to 4 hours of card transactions. After 4 hours, card payments are blocked on that terminal and only cash can be accepted.

questions.question: My company laptop was stolen from my car. What should I do, and what will IT do about it?
questions.reference_answer: Report it immediately to the IT Service Desk and your manager, with the asset tag if you have it and the last known location, and don't try to recover it yourself. IT starts a remote lock within 1 hour of the report, and if the laptop isn't recovered within 24 hours, or the theft is confirmed, the SOC orders a remote wipe.
key_facts: report immediately to the service desk and manager
give the asset tag and last known location
remote wipe if not recovered within 24 hours

evidence.quote: Immediately report a lost or stolen company laptop to the IT Service Desk and your manager.
Start a remote lock within 1 hour of the report.
If the laptop is not recovered within 24 hours, or a theft is confirmed, the SOC orders a remote wipe.

questions.question: My laptop still won't connect to BW-Corp Wi-Fi after restarting it. What else should I check, and how quickly will IT respond if I raise a ticket?
questions.reference_answer: Check the laptop's date and time, since a wrong clock causes certificate errors, and make sure it has connected to a wired network or the VPN in the last 60 days so its device certificate can renew. If it still fails, raise a P3 ticket with the asset tag and error message. P3 tickets get a first response within 4 business hours and a resolution target of 3 business days.
key_facts: connected to wired network or VPN in the last 60 days
first response 4 business hours, resolution 3 business days

evidence.quote: Make sure the laptop has connected to a wired network or the VPN in the last 60 days.
If it still fails, raise a P3 ticket in ServicePoint and include the laptop asset tag and the error message.
P3 4 business hours 3 business days

questions.question: I lost my hardware security key and it was my only sign-in method. How do I sign in now, and how long will that temporary access last?
questions.reference_answer: Call the IT Service Desk straight away, no later than 1 hour after noticing; the key is revoked when reported. After verifying your identity, the service desk issues a Temporary Access Pass, which is valid for 8 hours. evidence.quote: If the key was your only method, the IT Service Desk can issue a Temporary Access Pass after verifying your identity, as described in KB-1030.

Replacements are normally available within 3 business days.

questions.question: How do I clear the Microsoft Teams cache on Windows 11?
questions.reference_answer: Quit Teams completely, delete the contents of the Teams cache folder, then restart Teams. The folder location differs between classic Teams and new Teams.

questions.question: How do I take a screenshot of part of my screen on Windows 11?
questions.reference_answer: Press Windows key + Shift + S to open the Snipping Tool overlay, then select the area. The capture is copied to the clipboard.

questions.question: How do I save a Word document as a PDF?
questions.reference_answer: In Word, choose File, then Save As or Export, and pick PDF as the file type.

questions.question: How can I check my laptop's battery health on Windows 11?
questions.reference_answer: Run powercfg /batteryreport in Command Prompt or Terminal. It saves an HTML report that compares the battery's design capacity with its current full-charge capacity.

questions.question: What does the Chrome error DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN mean?
questions.reference_answer: The domain name couldn't be resolved by DNS, so Chrome can't find the site. Check the address for typos, check the network connection, and try flushing the DNS cache or changing DNS servers.
